notes: The Arduino UNO WiFi Rev2 is not in the catalogue, so it is a new part type with the Uno R3 header ports.
The breadboard in the image has rows j-f in the top half and e-a in the bottom half. The catalogue puts rows f-j in bank 'b', so the top-half holes are named with bank 'b'.

Circuit from the image: pin 2 -> green wire -> 3b.g. The 220 ohm resistor goes 3b.h to 6b.h. The LED anode (the bent, longer leg) is at 6b.i and its cathode is at 8b.i. A black wire joins 8b.h to the board's GND pin beside AREF (taken as GND.1).
The LED legs end in row i and the resistor sits in row h. These are the same column strips, so the connections are as listed.
The resistor value of 220 ohm comes from the text. The image shows only the resistor body, not its value.
The sketch reads analog pin A1, but nothing is wired to it, so it is not in the graph.
The second image is a screenshot of the Serial Monitor and has no circuit information.
